output.summary: An aromatic, spiny deciduous shrub or small tree native to Japan and Korea; its natural range also includes mainland China. Its scarlet berries burst open in autumn to scatter black seeds. Young leaves and ground or prepared fruits are used as flavorings in Japanese and Korean cooking.
output.edibilityNote: Mature fruits are ground as spice; immature berries are blanched, salted or simmered, while young leaves, shoots and male flowers are eaten in Japan and Korea.
